title: Hired In The Same Month
description:
Report every pair of different employees hired in the same calendar month of the same year. List each pair once, with the lower `id` first.

Name the columns `first_name`, `second_name` and `month`. Return the result in any order.
solutionSql:
SELECT a.name AS first_name, b.name AS second_name,
       strftime('%Y-%m', a.hire_date) AS month
FROM employees a
JOIN employees b
  ON a.id < b.id
 AND strftime('%Y-%m', a.hire_date) = strftime('%Y-%m', b.hire_date);
hint: Joining on a.id < b.id (rather than <>) is what stops each pair appearing twice.
outputExplanation: Ben and Cara were both hired in March 2019 — the only pair hired in the same calendar month.
schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE departments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  location TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  salary INTEGER,
  dept_id INTEGER,
  manager_id INTEGER,
  hire_date TEXT
);

Employees with NULL department and NULL salary

tests.name: Duplicate names and same hire dates
Zero and negative salaries, boundary dates
No pairs — all in different months
Three people hired in the same month — three pairs
Same month, different year — not a pair
tests.seedSql:

INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'A','X',100,1,NULL,'2020-06-01'),(2,'B','X',100,1,1,'2021-06-01');
